main_text.l: ꝏ icte, Holera: & wortt herba. Inde
notione Saxon. pyprʒ: unde hortus eis
su Sax. piprpraca, quod etiam contra-
ꝏ ittt, Prudentia] Vide ꝏ ewitt.
Malim ego à witt, Sax. piт, & ʒepit,
prudentum in eam rem consessus Sax.

page.notes: Several Saxon glosses are set in black letter or are very small; marked forms are doubtful. The handwritten "241" in the right margin is not printed text and is omitted. Marginal dagger-like cross marks (ꝏ) stand for printed reference symbols. The line "nibus" at the foot is the continuation of "Saxonibus" printed at the right, partly cut off.
